description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the New Hampshire RSA (Revised Statutes Annotated) — New Hampshire state law — by citation. "630:1" is capital murder; "540:2" lists grounds for landlord eviction. Accepts natural forms: "630:1", "RSA 630:1", "§ 630:1". Returns the current statutory text, the official catchline, chapter/title context, and the amendment HISTORY taken verbatim from the section's own "Source." line (e.g. "Source. 1971, 518:1. 1974, 34:1. ... 2019, 42:1, eff. May 30, 2019."). New Hampshire publishes the CURRENT text only — no per-year historical archive and no "view as of" picker, verified live; this tool says so rather than guessing. Keyless. Use for "what does RSA 630:1 say" or to check a New Hampshire statute a case or lease relies on.

citation.description: Section citation, chapter:section, e.g. "630:1" (capital murder) or "540:2" (landlord eviction grounds). Some sections carry a letter suffix, e.g. "630:1-a", or a letter-suffixed chapter, e.g. "632-A:2".
